intended_use.primary_intended_use: Provide educational decision-support risk estimates for Type 2 Diabetes Risk using structured patient clinical measurements.
intended_use.out_of_scope_use: Direct diagnostic substitution, prescribing therapy, acute emergency triage without clinician oversight.
intended_use.target_users: Patients, medical students, clinical researchers, educational users.

data.source: National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases / UCI Machine Learning Repository
data.known_limitations: All patients are females of Pima Indian heritage aged 21 and older. Zero values in glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, insulin, and BMI represent missing medical measurements that require imputation.

explainability.method: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) + LIME + Counterfactual Optimization
explainability.interpretability_level: Local feature attribution, global importance waterfall, actionable what-if changes.

ethical_considerations.fairness_and_bias: All patients are females of Pima Indian heritage aged 21 and older. Zero values in glucose, blood pressure, skin thickness, insulin, and BMI represent missing medical measurements that require imputation.
ethical_considerations.safety_recommendation: Educational risk estimate only. Real clinical diagnosis requires comprehensive physician consultation.
